notes.title: Halloween Update! - New Game Mode
notes.notes:
Greetings! ːsteamhappyː

We are in that time of the year where there are pumpkins, candies and monsters everywhere. And to celebrate it, we have added a completely new game mode: Nightmare.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36351782/57200da655bb566c21c7fa99c18f6c7eae47710b.gif

In the nightmare mode you will have to break into the school once again to recover 8 exams... But take care... This time there will be something waiting to prey you... ːsteammockingː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36351782/88d0f892e6b098c45df06ca5df87abfb0f7e361d.gif

If you are succesful, you will unlock a new Steam achievement, so... What are you waiting for?

Hope y'all are doing well!

The W&H Team
